_about: Public-domain Thomas Bradbury (1677-1759), Independent minister in London, Whig preacher of the fifth of November and Calvinist controversialist, for the Word Hoard: his ordination confession, The Doctrine of Justification, Twenty-eight Sermons, The Power of Christ over Plagues, The Mystery of Godliness, Jesus Christ the Brightness of Glory, The Necessity of Contending for Revealed Religion, the anniversary sermons, The Duty and Doctrine of Baptism, and his collected Sermons. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 96 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

bradbury-five-anniversary: Five anniversary sermons upon the fifth of November; the day of our happy revolution. By T. Bradbury.  1705 (catalogued 1705)
bradbury-confession: A confession of faith, at the publick ordination of Thomas Bradbury. London, July the tenth, 1707. With an exhortation to minister and people. By Mr. John Shower.  1707 (catalogued 1707)
bradbury-christians-joy: The Christian's joy in finishing his course. By Thomas Bradbury.  1713 (catalogued 1713)
bradbury-justification: The doctrine of justification explain'd and apply'd: in eight sermons. By Thomas Bradbury.  1716 (catalogued 1716)
bradbury-contending: The necessity of contending for revealed religion: with a sermon on the fifth of November, 1719. By Thomas Bradbury. To which is prefix'd, a letter from the Reverend Cotton Mather D.D. on the late disputes about the ever-blessed Trinity.  1720 (catalogued 1720)
bradbury-twenty-eight: Twenty-eight sermons concerning offences, revilings, and a confession of the faith; preach'd at Pinners-Hall. By Thomas Bradbury.  1723 (catalogued 1723)
bradbury-plagues: The power of Christ over plagues and health, and his name, as the God of Israel, consider'd; as arguments of his supreme deity: in ten sermons. To which is prefixed, an account of the anti-Arian lecture on Wednesdays. By Thomas Bradbury.  1724 (catalogued 1724)
bradbury-mystery-godliness: The Mystery of godliness, consider'd in lxi. sermons : wherein the deity of Christ is prov'd upon no other evidence than the Word of God, and with no other view than for the salvation of men, vol. 2 (London : Printed for Tho. Cox, 1726)
bradbury-brightness: Jesus Christ the brightness of glory, &c. In four sermons, preach'd at the Friday-lecture, in Little St. Helens. By Thomas Bradbury.  1729 (catalogued 1729)
bradbury-popish-justification: The popish doctrine of justification by works, consider'd; in a sermon at Pinners-Hall, Feb. 11, 1734-5. By Thomas Bradbury.  1735 (catalogued 1735)
bradbury-swearing: The sin and danger of profane swearing expos'd, in several sermons. By Thomas Bradbury.  1742 (catalogued 1742)
bradbury-six-sermons: Six sermons on Heb. VI. 12. ... By Thomas Bradbury.  1743 (catalogued 1743)
bradbury-baptism: The duty and doctrine of baptism : in thirteen sermons (London : Printed for J. Davidson [etc.], 1749)
